I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-team message. The reply confirms they're on the road tomorrow morning (Thu 15 Oct) and reachable on mobile. It also offers to block the time on their calendar or pass messages along while they're away.

I checked my own calendar for tomorrow and it's empty, so nothing of mine needs moving. That check doesn't cover Ilse's own meetings, so I can't say whether anything of theirs is affected. GBrain had nothing about this trip.
